nodes.label: Enrichment
nodes.rationale: Personal-scale only: capped, delayed, cached, stops when LinkedIn blocks.

nodes.label: Job
nodes.rationale: Same job appears in many alerts, so it is always deduplicated by numeric LinkedIn job_id.

nodes.label: Job store
nodes.rationale: Single owner of all persisted Alerts and Job knowledge; answers which Jobs need details or a score.

nodes.label: Rubric
nodes.rationale: Candidate's own priorities override the model's general opinion.

nodes.label: Bonuses (remote +1, contract +1)
nodes.rationale: Applied after band; only when stated; never lift a dealbreaker job out of 0-3; capped at 10.

nodes.label: Azure app registration
nodes.rationale: Personal accounts only, public client flows enabled for device-code sign-in, delegated Mail.Read.

nodes.label: Anthropic Batch API scoring
nodes.rationale: 50% cheaper, async; resume BATCH_ID collects earlier batches.

nodes.label: CLI commands (login, run, fetch, jobs, enrich, score, resume, report)
nodes.norm_label: cli commands (login, run, fetch, jobs, enrich, score, resume, report)

nodes.label: Device-code login (login command)
nodes.rationale: Caches refresh token so later runs never prompt and are safe to schedule; fetch/run exit 1 when sign-in expired so schedulers can flag it.

nodes.label: data/rubric.md (Job-fit rubric)
nodes.rationale: Draft written by Claude from the CV; ASSUMPTION lines are guesses. Part of the prompt, so edits trigger re-scoring.

nodes.label: Prompt hash
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint of model+effort+instructions+CV+Rubric+schema; mismatching scores are stale and re-scored, enabling incremental scoring.

nodes.label: Data and privacy (git-ignored data)
nodes.rationale: Only rubric tracked; CV, emails (links carry LinkedIn auth tokens), token cache and keys kept out of git.

nodes.label: Polite enrichment
nodes.rationale: 3-7s random delay, max 40 per run, disk cache, stop on 429/999 to avoid LinkedIn blocking.
